name: ForceGen steered-MD dataset (Ni, Kaplan & Buehler)
notes: All-atom steered MD of ~7,000 proteins selected from BSDB (NAMD, CHARMM, generalized-Born implicit solvent). Metadata indexed only: the per-protein force-extension records are large and are not copied here.
unit_system: physical (kcal/mol/A force field units, reported forces in pN)
